```{r import plotting data}
read_bcftools_stats <- function(file,
                                sections = c("SN","TSTV","SiS","AF","QUAL","IDD","ST","DP")) {
  lines <- readLines(file)
  stats <- list()
  for(sec in sections) {
    sec_lines <- grep(paste0("^", sec, "\t"), lines, value=TRUE)
    if(length(sec_lines)==0) next
    # strip off the “SEC\t” prefix, read as table
    df <- read.table(
      text       = sub(paste0("^", sec, "\t"), "", sec_lines),
      sep        = "\t",
      header     = FALSE,
      stringsAsFactors = FALSE
    )
    stats[[sec]] <- df
  }
  stats
}


# read in your .stats file
stats <- read_bcftools_stats("DMP.full.vcf.stats")

# Summary numbers
sn <- stats$SN
colnames(sn) <- c("ID","key","value")  # adjust if 2-col only
sn[,-1]->sn

## In keys, replace "number of " with ""
sn$key <- gsub("number of ","",sn$key)
## In keys, remove ":"
sn$key <- gsub(":","",sn$key)
## Remove "samples" and "no-ALTs" from keys
subset(sn, key != "samples" & key != "no-ALTs")->sn

# TSTV: transition/transversion counts
tstv <- stats$TSTV
colnames(tstv) <- c("ID","ts","tv","ts/tv","ts (1st ALT)","tv (1st ALT)","ts/tv (1st ALT)")
tstv[,-1]->tstv

# remove all but the ts/tv ratios
tstv[,c(3,6)]->tstv
## make long format
gather(tstv, key="type", value="count")->tstv


# AF: allele-frequency distribution (bin vs count)
af <- stats$AF
colnames(af) <- c("ID","allele_frequency","number_SNPs","number_transitions","number_transversions","number_indels","repeat-consistent","repeat-inconsistent","not_applicable")
af[,-1]->af


# IDD: indel distribution
idd <- stats$IDD
colnames(idd) <- c("ID","length", "count")
idd[,-1]->idd

# ST: Substitution types
st <- stats$ST
colnames(st) <- c("ID","type","count")
st[,-1]->st
```

```{r plot TSTV, include=TRUE, fig.width=11/3, fig.height=8.5/3}
# Plot TSTV
ggplot(tstv, aes(x=type,y=count))+
  geom_bar(stat="identity", fill="blue")+
  scale_y_continuous(expand=c(0,0), limits=c(0, max(tstv$count)*1.2))+
  scale_x_discrete(limits=tstv$type)+
  labs(x="", y="Count")+
  #JFMVTheme +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=45, hjust=1))+
  # add repelled text labels, centered on the bars, rounded to 3 decimal
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = count),
    nudge_y = 0.1,
    size = 3,
    show.legend = FALSE,
    segment.size = 0.2,
    segment.color = "black",
    max.overlaps = Inf
  ) -> p2

p2

```


```{r plot IDD, include=TRUE, fig.width=11/3, fig.height=8.5/3}
# Plot IDD
ggplot(idd, aes(x=length,y=count/1e6))+
  geom_bar(stat="identity", fill="blue")+
  scale_y_continuous(expand=c(0,0), limits=c(0, max(idd$count/1e6)*1.2))+
  labs(x="Length (deletions negative)", y="Count (x1e6)")+
  JFMVTheme +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=45, hjust=1))
```

```{r plot ST, include=TRUE, fig.width=11/3, fig.height=8.5/3}
# Plot ST
ggplot(st, aes(x=type,y=count/1e6))+
  geom_bar(stat="identity", fill="blue")+
  scale_y_continuous(expand=c(0,0), limits=c(0, max(st$count/1e6)*1.2))+
  labs(x="Substitution", y="Count")+
  JFMVTheme +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle=45, hjust=1))+
  # add repelled text labels, centered on the bars, rounded to 3 decimal
  ggrepel::geom_text_repel(
    aes(label = round(count/1e6,3) ),
    nudge_y = 0.75,
    size = 3,
    show.legend = FALSE,
    segment.size = 0.2,
    segment.color = "black",
    max.overlaps = Inf
  ) -> p7

p7
```
